text:
mia chen: Drafting the internal release blast for the 2026-03-25 change window (US-EAST). Need a quick review for the release notes, rollback commands, and version pin. Planning a 10% canary for 30m. Any red flags? :eyes:

samir lal: Please pin the runtime and model versions in the notes. Recommend runtime -> 2.12.1+gpu-patch, model -> rwd-serve-v2.3.5. Call out perf variance on long sequences.

jordan r: +1 on the pins. Also add a callout for Dedicated customers about maintenance: they'll need node restarts, plan for 2h window if they're on pinned hardware.

kevin b: We should include a short rollback snippet and a tl;dr for Sales. Put the rollback CLI and a link to the runbook.

mia chen: Draft release notes snippet below — feel free to edit for tone.

```
Release: runtime 2.12.1+gpu-patch, model rwd-serve-v2.3.5
- Summary: Fixes to prefix KV caching and batching heuristics to reduce tail latency.
- Impact: Minor perf variance on sequences >1024 tokens under certain quantized kernels.
- Canary: 10% for 30 minutes, monitoring dashboards + logs.
- Rollback (ops): `rw-deploy rollback --service=runtime --to=2.12.0 --tag=2026-03-25-canary`
- Rollback (model): `rw-model rollback --name=rwd-serve --version=v2.3.4`
```

release-czar: For internal blast, add this one-liner for GTM: "Transparent perf and reliability improvements; no API surface changes." Also add a note for support about expected alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @mia chen: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (10% traffic, 30m). Will post status in thread.

natalie: Small wording nit: instead of "minor perf variance" say "small perf variance expected for very long sequences" — less alarming.

samir lal: Ops checklist snippet to include in thread (short):
```
- Monitor: /dash/realtime/latency, /dash/errors
- If error rate > 1% or latency > 2x baseline: run rollback command above and notify #incidents
- Post-rollback: run `rw-metrics refresh` and verify requests-per-second stability for 15m
```

kevin b: Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback (internal) — make sure SRE oncall reads this before canary.

jordan r: One more: pinning note for Dedicated customers: add this snippet to the customer email: "If you operate a Dedicated cluster, we will schedule a short node restart to apply runtime patch; please confirm blackout windows if you cannot accept restarts."

mia chen: OK I'll integrate these edits and send the internal blast at 10:00 PT on deploy day. Final checklist: pins, rollback commands, canary times, runbook link, sales one-liner, support alert copy.

samir lal: I'll take on on-call for the canary window. Ping me in the thread when it's live. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started (canary id: c-20260325-01). Posting updates here.

mia chen: Thanks everyone — LGTM.

release-czar: Saved draft to /docs/internal/releases/2026-03-25-dry-run (will edit copy for send).
